parameters.name: AccessId
parameters.description: The AccessKey ID of the cloud account.

parameters.name: AccountId
parameters.description: The ID of the cloud account.

parameters.name: BindId
parameters.description: The binding ID. Call the [ListBindAccount](https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListBindAccount) operation to obtain the binding ID.

parameters.name: CloudCode
parameters.description:
The code for the cloud service provider. Valid values:

- qcloud: Tencent Cloud

- aliyun: Alibaba Cloud

- hcloud: Huawei Cloud

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the threat analysis data center is located. Select a region based on the location of your assets. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in mainland China or the China (Hong Kong) region.

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. An administrator can specify this parameter to perform the operation from the perspective of a member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The type of the view. Valid values:

- 0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: The view of all accounts that are managed by your enterprise.
